name: Coldseam Tier-Hop Courier's Full Transit Set
description:
Built for someone who moves between Tier 1 and Tier 4 in a single shift. The base is a fitted long-sleeve in neutral heather grey with sealed neural port collar — unremarkable at every checkpoint. Over it, a reversible shell jacket: one side matte olive with cargo pockets and a hood, the other side clean charcoal with a minimal structured collar that reads professional. Pants are tapered dark navy with hidden zip pockets and articulated knees. Shoes are a sleek low-profile runner in dark grey, clean enough for a Tier 4 lobby, durable enough for Shelf transit.

A compact sling pack in waxed black nylon with RFID-blocking inner lining and false-bottom compartment completes the set. The whole kit compresses to bag-size. Every piece is chosen to read differently depending on which side of the jacket faces out.
functionality: Reversible jacket for rapid tier-presentation shift, RFID-blocking sling pack with false-bottom compartment, neural port collar access, articulated knees for active transit, full outfit compresses for concealed carry.
what_it_says: I belong wherever I need to be, and by the time you figure out I don't, I'm already gone.
story_hooks: The false-bottom compartment of the sling pack currently contains a sealed data chip addressed to someone who died two weeks ago.
A Tier 4 building's facial recognition flagged the courier — not for a crime, but because their face matches a Spire family's missing-person file from eleven years ago.
The reversible jacket's charcoal side has a small embroidered mark inside the collar — a symbol that opens a door in the Shelf that shouldn't exist.
related_entities: TESSERA CORPONATION Aegis CorpSec Hardened Security BCI

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, adaptable silhouette designed for seamless code-switching between corporate and street environments. The reversible jacket is the centerpiece—flip it and the entire aesthetic transforms from street operative to junior corpo. Layered, compact, and deliberately unremarkable; built to blend rather than stand out.
physical_description.fit: Fitted through the torso with tapered legs; compression-friendly without being restrictive. The long-sleeve base is snug at wrists and collar. Pants have articulated knees for mobility. Overall impression: efficient, athletic, travel-ready.
physical_description.primary_material: Base layer: synth-blend heather grey with moisture-wicking properties. Reversible shell: ballistic-weave nylon with matte finish on olive side, smooth technical weave on charcoal. Pants: stretch-integrated dark navy composite. Shoes: molded TPE sole with tech-mesh upper. Pack: waxed nylon with RF-shielded compartments.
physical_description.texture: Smooth to matte overall; the olive side reads slightly textured, the charcoal side glass-smooth. Cargo pockets are reinforced with subtle quilting. Knees feature articulated flex panels. Neural collar is lined with soft conductive mesh. Pack surface is waxy, slightly grip-textured.
physical_description.color_scheme: Heather grey base, reversible jacket in matte olive and charcoal, dark navy tapered pants, dark grey runner shoes. All colors desaturated and professional—nothing that flags attention at checkpoints.
physical_description.closures: Reversible jacket: friction-fit magnetic toggles disguised as standard zippers on both sides. Base layer: magnetic thermal snaps at collar (housing neural port pass-through). Pants: concealed magnetic fly with hidden zip pockets on thighs. Shoes: tension-lock laces. Pack: recessed magnetic snap flap with redundant friction-seal.
distinctive_features: Sealed neural port collar with conductive mesh lining—allows quick augment interface without removing jacket
Reversible shell jacket: olive side reads street/courier, charcoal side reads junior corpo
Hidden zip pockets on pants thighs (contents invisible when closed)
False-bottom compartment in sling pack with RFID-blocking Faraday mesh
Articulated knee panels for stairs and climbing
Cargo pockets on olive side with discrete reinforcement stitching
All zippers and fasteners matte-finished to avoid reflective giveaways
Waxed pack surface resists scanner interference and moisture
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 functional wear with Tier 2 materials and construction quality. Signals working professional with street credibility. Expensive enough to pass scrutiny, understated enough to not invite theft.
physical_description.cultural_context: Courier, data-runner, or someone with legitimate reasons to move between corporate and street zones. The outfit says: 'I belong everywhere and nowhere.' Worn by freelancers, transit workers, and those with augment subscriptions that span multiple networks.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new (signals recent Φ spend), but designed to weather well—scuffs on shoes look intentional, minor creases in the pack suggest actual use. Never looks neglected, always looks functional.

image_prompt: A sharp fashion shot of a lean, mixed-heritage model wearing the Coldseam Tier-Hop set—charcoal side of reversible jacket facing camera, creating a clean corporate silhouette. The model stands in a neo-brutalist GLMZ transit hub, cool LED strips overhead casting blue-white light. One hand adjusts the neural port collar, revealing the conductive mesh beneath. The black waxed sling pack hangs diagonally across the torso. Second image shows the model mid-flip, jacket reversing to olive with cargo details visible, suggesting transformation mid-mission. Moody, cinematic, high contrast, gritty urban cyberpunk aesthetic. Dark background with neon grid reflections. --ar 2:3 --v 6
